source_refs.note: Roman Urdu: practice long questions written from Chapter 5 (PDF 93-118), not printed in the book; same questions and order as the English set. Drafts needing academic review.

blocks.text: Yeh chapter 5 (Solids and Fluid Dynamics) ke poore chapter se practice long questions (tafseeli sawal) hain, Board ke long question ki shakal mein: har 5 number ke theory sawal (definition, wazahat, derivation) ke baad usi mauzu ka 3 number ka numerical hai. Har sawal ka model jawab hai; numericals qadam ba qadam hal kiye gaye hain.

blocks.prompt:
1 Define stress and strain and name their kinds. Explain tensile, volumetric and shear strain with their formulas, and define Young's modulus with its unit. (5 marks)
(Stress aur strain ki definition aur qisamein likhein. Tensile, volumetric aur shear strain formulas ke saath samjhayein, aur Young's modulus ki definition aur unit likhein.)
blocks.explanation:
Stress: fi unit area lagai gayi force jo jism ki shakal, hajm ya lambai badle.
Stress (σ) = Force (F)/Area (A) ... (5.1)
SI unit: N m⁻², jise pascal (Pa) kehte hain. Lambai badalne wala tensile stress, hajm badalne wala volume stress, aur shakal badalne wala shear stress hai.

Strain: stress lagne par solid ki deformation (bigaar) ka paimana.
(i) Tensile (ya compressive) strain: aik dimension mein lambai ki fractional tabdeeli (Fig. 5.3a).
Strain (ε) = ΔL/L₀ ... (5.2)
Yeh lambaiyon ki nisbat hai, is liye dimensionless aur be-unit hai. Tensile stress se tensile strain, compressive stress se compressive strain.
(ii) Volumetric strain: jab stress hajm badle to fi unit hajm, hajm ki tabdeeli (Fig. 5.3b).
Volumetric strain = ΔV/V₀ ... (5.3)
(iii) Shear strain: agar do aamne saamne ke rukh y faasle par hon aur shear stress se aik rukh Δx khiske (Fig. 5.3c),
γ = Δx/y = tan θ ... (5.4)
Chhote angle θ (radian) ke liye tan θ ≅ θ, is liye γ = θ ... (5.5)

Young's modulus: fi unit strain lagaya gaya stress.
Y = Tensile stress/Tensile strain = (F/A)/(ΔL/L₀) ... (5.6)
Is ki unit stress wali N m⁻² ya Pa hai. Kuch materials ki qeematein Table 5.1 mein hain (maslan steel 200 × 10⁹ N m⁻², copper 110 × 10⁹ N m⁻²).

book_ref.quote: Strain is a measure of the deformation of a solid when stress is applied to it.

blocks.prompt:
2 A wire 2.0 m long with cross-sectional area 8.0 × 10⁻⁷ m² stretches by 2.0 mm under a load of 160 N. Find (i) the stress (ii) the strain (iii) the Young's modulus of the material. (3 marks)
(2.0 m lambi taar jis ka area 8.0 × 10⁻⁷ m² hai, 160 N bojh se 2.0 mm khinchti hai. (i) stress (ii) strain (iii) material ka Young's modulus maloom karein.)
blocks.explanation: Stress = F/A, strain = ΔL/L₀, aur Y in ki nisbat hai.

book_ref.quote: It has the same unit as that of stress i.e., N m⁻² or Pa.

blocks.final_answer: Stress = 2.0 × 10⁸ N m⁻², strain = 1.0 × 10⁻³, Y = 2.0 × 10¹¹ N m⁻²

blocks.prompt:
3 Describe Searle's method for determining the Young's modulus of a wire: the apparatus, the procedure and how Y is obtained from the graph. (5 marks)
(Taar ka Young's modulus maloom karne ka Searle's method bayan karein: apparatus, tareeqa-e-kaar aur graph se Y kaise milta hai.)
blocks.explanation:
Apparatus (Fig. 5.4): Do taarein, auxiliary (reference) wire aur test (experimental) wire, baraabar lambai, aik material aur aik diameter ki, sakht support se latakti hain. Neeche ke sire ufuqi bars (frames F₁ aur F₂) se jure hain. Reference wire ki bar ke hook par mustaqil wazan aur test wire par hanger latkaya jata hai taake taarein khinchi rahein aur bal na parein. Dono frames ke darmiyan spirit level aur micrometer hota hai.

Tareeqa:
1. Metre scale se taar ki asal lambai L₀ naapein.
2. Screw gauge se taar ka diameter d kai jagah naap kar average lein.
3. Micrometer ghuma kar spirit level ufuqi karein; yeh reference reading likhein.
4. Test wire par mazeed wazan dalein; taar lambi hone se spirit level jhukta hai.
5. Micrometer ghuma kar spirit level dobara ufuqi karein. Doosri reading se pehli minus karne par extension ΔL milti hai.
6. Stress aur strain nikalein:
Stress = Wazan/taar ka area = F/A = mg/πr²
Strain = ΔL/L₀
7. Bojh barha kar mazeed qeematein lein.
8. Stress ko strain ke muqable mein plot karein; graph seedhi line hona chahiye. Is ki slope taar ka Young's modulus Y hai.

book_ref.quote: Experimentally, the magnitude of Young's modulus for a material in the form of wire can be found out

blocks.prompt:
4 In a Searle's experiment, a wire of original length 2.5 m and radius 0.50 mm extends by 1.25 mm when a mass of 4.0 kg is added. Find the stress, the strain and the Young's modulus. (Take π = 3.14.) (3 marks)
(Searle's experiment mein 2.5 m asal lambai aur 0.50 mm radius wali taar 4.0 kg mass dalne par 1.25 mm lambi hoti hai. Stress, strain aur Young's modulus maloom karein. (π = 3.14 lein.))
blocks.explanation: Stress = mg/πr², strain = ΔL/L₀; Y = stress/strain.

book_ref.quote: Repeat the above steps by increasing load on test wire to obtain more values of stresses and strains.

blocks.final_answer: Stress ≈ 5.0 × 10⁷ N m⁻², strain = 5.0 × 10⁻⁴, Y ≈ 1.0 × 10¹¹ N m⁻²

blocks.prompt:
5 Draw and explain the stress-strain curve of a ductile material. Explain proportional limit, elastic limit (yield point), plastic deformation, ultimate tensile strength and fracture. Also define ductile and brittle substances. (5 marks)
(Ductile material ka stress-strain curve bana kar samjhayein. Proportional limit, elastic limit (yield point), plastic deformation, ultimate tensile strength aur fracture samjhayein. Ductile aur brittle ashya ki definition bhi likhein.)
blocks.explanation:
Tensile test: mechanical testing machine mein dhaat ki taar muqarrar raftaar se khenchi jati hai; electronic aala stress naapta hai aur stress-strain curve X-Y chart recorder par khud banta hai (Fig. 5.5).

Hissa OA, proportional limit: Shuru mein stress strain ke saath seedha (linear) barhta hai point A tak, jo proportional limit σₚ hai: woh sab se zyada stress jo stress aur strain ki seedhi nisbat khoye baghair bardasht ho. OA mein Hooke's law (strain stress ke seedha mutanasib) lagu hai. A se B tak mutanasib nahi.

Elastic limit (yield point B): O aur B ke darmiyan kahin bhi bojh hatane par curve wapas usi raaste aata hai aur material asal lambai par aa jata hai. Hissa OB elastic hai. B yield point hai aur B par stress elastic limit σₑ hai.

Plastic deformation: Elastic limit se aage stress barhane par namoona mustaqil badal jata hai aur stress hatane par asal shakal nahi pata. Yeh plasticity hai, hissa B se C.

Ultimate tensile strength (C): woh zyada se zyada stress σᵤ jo material bardasht kare; material ki nominal strength.
Fracture (D): C ke baad material D par toot jata hai, fracture stress σf.

Ductile ashya tootne tak plastic deformation sehti hain, maslan lead, copper, wrought iron.
Brittle ashya elastic limit ke foran baad toot jati hain, maslan glass, high carbon steel; beryllium, bismuth, chromium brittle dhaatein hain.

book_ref.quote: A typical stress-strain curve for a ductile material is shown in Fig. 5.5.

blocks.prompt:
6 A copper wire of diameter 2.0 mm and length 1.5 m carries a load of 300 N. Assuming it stays in the region OA, find (i) the stress (ii) the strain (iii) the extension. Take Y for copper = 110 × 10⁹ N m⁻² (Table 5.1) and π = 3.14. (3 marks)
(2.0 mm diameter aur 1.5 m lambi copper ki taar par 300 N bojh hai. Farz karein yeh hissa OA mein rehti hai; (i) stress (ii) strain (iii) extension maloom karein. Copper ka Y = 110 × 10⁹ N m⁻² (Table 5.1), π = 3.14.)
blocks.explanation: Hissa OA mein Hooke's law lagu hai, is liye strain = stress/Y; phir ΔL = strain × L₀.

book_ref.quote: Hooke's law which states that the strain (deformation) is directly proportional to stress

blocks.final_answer: Stress = 9.55 × 10⁷ N m⁻², strain = 8.7 × 10⁻⁴, extension = 1.3 mm

blocks.prompt:
7 What is strain energy? Derive an expression for the energy stored in a stretched spring, and show that the strain energy per unit volume of a stretched material is ½ × stress × strain = ½Y(ΔL/L)². (5 marks)
(Strain energy kya hai? Khenche hue spring mein jama energy ka formula derive karein, aur sabit karein ke khenche hue material mein fi unit hajm strain energy ½ × stress × strain = ½Y(ΔL/L)² hai.)
blocks.explanation:
Strain energy: Jab force se jism deform hota hai to elastic restoring force ke khilaf kaam hota hai. Yeh kaam jism mein potential energy ke tor par jama hota hai, jo molecules ke mean jagah se hatne se P.E. ka izafa hai.

Khenche spring ki energy: Spring ko force F se Δx khencha jata hai (Fig. 5.6). Elastic limit ke andar extension force ke seedha mutanasib hai, is liye force zero se F tak yaksaan barhti hai (Fig. 5.7). Average force ½F hai.
Kaam = Average force × force ki simt mein faasla
W = ½F × Δx ... (5.7)
Hooke's law se F = kΔx, is liye
W = (½kΔx)(Δx) = ½kΔx²
W = force-extension graph ke neeche tikon OPQ ka area.
Yeh kaam strain energy ke tor par jama hota hai: E = ½F.Δx = ½kΔx²

Fi unit hajm: Area A, lambai L aur extension ΔL wale material ka hajm AL hai. Is liye
U = ½ × (F × ΔL)/(A × L)
U = ½ × (F/A) × (ΔL/L) ... (5.8)
U = ½ × stress × strain ... (5.9)
Eq. (5.6) se F/A = Y × (ΔL/L). Eq. (5.8) mein rakhne se:
U = ½Y × (ΔL/L) × (ΔL/L) = ½Y(ΔL/L)² ... (5.10)
Yeh stressed material mein fi unit hajm jama strain energy deti hai.

book_ref.quote: Consider a material in the form of a spring as shown in Fig. 5.6.

blocks.prompt:
8 A steel wire (Y = 2.0 × 10¹¹ N m⁻²) of length 2.0 m and cross-sectional area 1.0 × 10⁻⁶ m² is stretched by a force of 100 N. Find (i) the extension (ii) the strain energy stored (iii) the strain energy per unit volume. (3 marks)
(Steel ki taar (Y = 2.0 × 10¹¹ N m⁻²), lambai 2.0 m, area 1.0 × 10⁻⁶ m², 100 N force se khenchi jati hai. (i) extension (ii) jama strain energy (iii) fi unit hajm strain energy maloom karein.)
blocks.explanation: Y = (F/A)/(ΔL/L) se ΔL nikalein; energy = ½FΔL; phir hajm AL se taqseem karein.

book_ref.quote: then the volume of the material will be AL

blocks.prompt:
9 State Archimedes' principle. Derive an expression for the upthrust on a solid cylinder immersed in a liquid and show that it equals the weight of the liquid displaced. (5 marks)
(Archimedes' principle bayan karein. Liquid mein doobe solid cylinder par upthrust ka formula derive karein aur sabit karein ke yeh hataye gaye liquid ke wazan ke baraabar hai.)
blocks.explanation:
Upthrust: liquid ke andar rakhi cheez par oopar ki force lagti hai jis se wazan zahiri tor par kam lagta hai; yeh liquid ka upthrust hai.

Archimedes' principle: Jab koi cheez poori ya juzwi tor par liquid mein doobi ho to us par upthrust lagta hai jo hataye gaye liquid ke wazan ke baraabar hai.

Derivation: Area A aur unchai h ka solid cylinder ρ density wale liquid mein dooba hai (Fig. 5.8). Is ke oopar aur neeche ke rukh ki gehraai h₁ aur h₂ hai. To
h₂ − h₁ = h ... (5.11)
In gehraiyon par pressure:
P₁ = ρgh₁ aur P₂ = ρgh₂
Oopar aur neeche ke rukh par forces:
F₁ = P₁A = ρgh₁A aur F₂ = P₂A = ρgh₂A
Yeh mukhalif rukhon par hain, is liye net force (upthrust) in ka farq hai:
F₂ − F₁ = ρgA(h₂ − h₁) ... (5.12)
Upthrust = ρgAh
Upthrust = ρgV ... (5.13)
Ah cylinder ka hajm V hai jo hataye gaye liquid ke hajm ke baraabar hai; is liye ρgV hataye gaye liquid ka wazan hai. Yahi Archimedes' principle hai.

book_ref.quote: Consider a solid cylinder of cross-sectional area A and height h immersed in a liquid

blocks.prompt:
10 An empty balloon weighs 60 N and is filled with 15 m³ of hydrogen (density 0.09 kg m⁻³). The density of air is 1.3 kg m⁻³. Find the maximum load it can lift besides its own weight. (3 marks)
(Khaali balloon ka wazan 60 N hai aur is mein 15 m³ hydrogen (density 0.09 kg m⁻³) bhari hai. Hawa ki density 1.3 kg m⁻³ hai. Apne wazan ke ilawa yeh zyada se zyada kitna bojh utha sakta hai?)
blocks.explanation: Upthrust = hataye gaye hawa ka wazan; yeh balloon + hydrogen + bojh ke baraabar hona chahiye.

book_ref.quote: How much maximum contents the balloon can lift besides its own weight?

blocks.final_answer: Zyada se zyada izafi bojh ≈ 118 N

blocks.title: Wazahat
blocks.text: Kitab ki Example 5.3 ka aakhri jawab 41 N chhapa hai, magar usi hisaab se w₂ = 127.4 − 80 − 8.82 = 38.58 N, yani taqreeban 38.6 N banta hai, 41 N nahi. Yahan wahi durust tareeqa hai.

blocks.prompt:
11 State the principle of floatation. When does an object float or sink? Explain how floatation is used in ships, a wooden block, a hot-air balloon and a submarine. (5 marks)
(Principle of floatation bayan karein. Cheez kab tairti ya doobti hai? Jahaz, lakri ke block, garam hawa ke balloon aur submarine mein floatation ka istemaal samjhayein.)
blocks.explanation:
Doobna aur tairna: Cheez doobti hai agar us ka wazan upthrust se zyada ho. Tairti hai agar wazan upthrust ke baraabar ya kam ho. Tairte waqt upthrust us ke wazan ke baraabar hota hai aur cheez juzwi doobi ho sakti hai. Upthrust hamesha hataye gaye fluid ke wazan ke baraabar hota hai.

Principle of floatation: Tairti cheez itna fluid hatati hai jis ka wazan cheez ke wazan ke baraabar ho.
Archimedes' principle liquids aur gases dono par lagu hai.

Istemaal:
1. Garam hawa ka balloon: is ki density aas paas ki hawa se kam hai; buoyant force wazan se zyada ho to yeh uthta hai. Garam hawa ki miqdaar badal kar control hota hai.
2. Lakri ka block: yeh tairta hai kyunke baraabar hajm ke paani ka wazan block se zyada hai; yeh utna hi doobta hai jitne mein hataya gaya paani us ke wazan ke baraabar ho.
3. Jahaz aur kashtiyan: floatation par banaye jate hain; musafiron aur samaan samet wazan upthrust se zyada ho to jahaz doob jaye.
4. Submarine: jab us ke hajm ke baraabar paani ka wazan us ke wazan se zyada ho to tairti hai. Is mein tanks hain jo samandari paani se bhare ya khaali kiye jate hain. Bharne se wazan barhta hai aur upthrust se zyada ho to doob jati hai. Oopar aane ke liye tanks khaali kiye jate hain.

book_ref.quote: This is the principle of floatation. It states that:

blocks.prompt:
12 A wooden block of volume 1.0 × 10⁻² m³ and mass 6.0 kg floats on water (ρ = 1000 kg m⁻³). Find (i) the upthrust on it (ii) the volume of the block under water (iii) the fraction of its volume immersed. (3 marks)
(1.0 × 10⁻² m³ hajm aur 6.0 kg mass ka lakri ka block paani (ρ = 1000 kg m⁻³) par tairta hai. (i) us par upthrust (ii) paani ke neeche block ka hajm (iii) dooba hua hissa (fraction) maloom karein.)
blocks.explanation: Tairte jism ke liye upthrust = wazan; dooba hua hajm hataye gaye paani ka hajm hai.

book_ref.quote: In case of floating object, the object may be partially immersed.

blocks.final_answer: Upthrust = 58.8 N; dooba hajm = 6.0 × 10⁻³ m³; block ka 0.60 (60%) hissa paani mein

blocks.prompt:
13 Explain the terms streamline, steady flow and turbulent flow, and why two streamlines cannot cross. State the conditions of an ideal fluid. Define rate of flow and derive the formula rate of flow = Av. (5 marks)
(Streamline, steady flow aur turbulent flow ki wazahat karein, aur batayein ke do streamlines kyun nahi kaat saktin. Ideal fluid ki sharait likhein. Rate of flow ki definition likhein aur formula rate of flow = Av derive karein.)
blocks.explanation:
Streamline (laminar) flow: agar kisi nuqte se guzarne wala har zarra bilkul pehle zarron wale raaste par chale. Yeh hamwar raasta streamline hai; seedha ya kham-daar ho sakta hai aur kisi nuqte par tangent bahao ki simt deta hai. Agar P, Q, R par velocity waqt ke saath na badle to bahao steady hai (Fig. 5.12). Do streamlines aik doosre ko kaat nahi saktin.

Steady flow: agar bahao ka majmooi pattern waqt ke saath na badle; har zarra pichhle zarre wali line par chalta hai.

Turbulent flow: fluid ka be-qaida ya ghair-mustaqil bahao. Aik khaas velocity se oopar harkat be-qaida ho jati hai, velocity achanak badalti hai aur bhanwar bante hain; zarron ke raaste badalte rehte hain (Fig. 5.13).

Ideal fluid: (1) non-viscous, tehon mein ragar nahi; (2) incompressible, density mustaqil; (3) steady bahao.

Rate of flow: pipe ke kisi hisse se fi unit waqt guzarne wala fluid ka hajm.
Derivation: Area A wale pipe mein fluid v velocity se behta hai (Fig. 5.14). Waqt t mein faasla
ℓ = vt
Waqt t mein guzarne wala hajm = A × ℓ = Avt
Rate of flow = Hajm/Waqt = Avt/t = Av ... (5.14)
SI unit: m³ s⁻¹ (kabhi L s⁻¹).

book_ref.quote: Let the velocity of the fluid be v and it flows through the pipe for time t

blocks.prompt:
14 Water flows at 2.0 m s⁻¹ through a pipe of internal radius 1.5 cm. Find (i) the rate of flow (ii) the time needed to fill a tank of 0.50 m³. (Take π = 3.14.) (3 marks)
(1.5 cm andaruni radius wale pipe mein paani 2.0 m s⁻¹ se behta hai. (i) rate of flow (ii) 0.50 m³ ki tanki bharne ka waqt maloom karein. (π = 3.14.))
blocks.explanation: Rate of flow = Av; waqt = hajm ÷ rate of flow.

book_ref.quote: The rate of flow of a fluid through a pipe is the volume of the fluid passing through any section of pipe per unit time.

blocks.final_answer: Rate of flow = 1.41 × 10⁻³ m³ s⁻¹; waqt ≈ 354 s (takreeban 5.9 minute)

blocks.prompt:
15 Starting from the conservation of mass, derive the equation of continuity A₁v₁ρ₁ = A₂v₂ρ₂ for steady flow through a pipe of non-uniform cross-section, reduce it to A₁v₁ = A₂v₂ for an incompressible fluid, and use it to explain why squeezing a rubber pipe increases the flow velocity. (5 marks)
(Mass ke conservation se shuru kar ke ghair-yaksaan pipe mein steady bahao ke liye A₁v₁ρ₁ = A₂v₂ρ₂ derive karein, incompressible fluid ke liye ise A₁v₁ = A₂v₂ banayein, aur is se samjhayein ke rubber pipe dabane se bahao ki velocity kyun barhti hai.)
blocks.explanation:
Bayan: Pipe ke kisi bhi nuqte par area aur fluid ki speed ka hasil-e-zarb (Av) mustaqil hai; yeh fi second bahao ka hajm (flow rate) hai.
Av = Mustaqil = Hajm/waqt

Derivation: Ghair-yaksaan pipe mein fluid steady behta hai (Fig. 5.15). Chhote waqt Δt mein neeche ke sire (area A₁) par fluid v₁ velocity se Δx₁ chalta hai:
Δx₁ = v₁Δt ... (5.15)
A₁ se dakhil hajm: V = A₁Δx₁ = A₁v₁Δt
Agar wahan density ρ₁ ho to dakhil mass
Δm₁ = A₁v₁Δt × ρ₁
Isi tarah oopar ke sire (area A₂, velocity v₂, density ρ₂) se usi waqt Δt mein nikalne wala mass
Δm₂ = A₂v₂Δt × ρ₂
Incompressible fluid aur steady bahao mein mass mehfooz rehta hai: A₁ se dakhil mass = A₂ se nikalne wala mass.
Δm₁ = Δm₂ ... (5.16)
A₁v₁Δt × ρ₁ = A₂v₂Δt × ρ₂
A₁v₁ρ₁ = A₂v₂ρ₂ ... (5.17)
Yeh equation of continuity hai. Incompressible fluid ki density mustaqil (ρ₁ = ρ₂) hai, is liye
A₁v₁ = A₂v₂ ... (5.18)

Matlab: steady bahao mein andar aane ka rate bahar jane ke rate ke baraabar hai; yeh pipe mein behte fluid ke mass ke conservation ko sabit karta hai. Jahan pipe tang ho wahan fluid tez chalta hai.

Rubber pipe dabana: dabane se area kam hota hai (A₂ < A₁), is liye A₁v₁ = A₂v₂ ke mutabiq wahi flow rate rakhne ke liye v₂ barhti hai (5.10).

book_ref.quote: Consider a fluid flowing through a pipe of non-uniform size.

blocks.prompt:
16 Water flows at 0.50 m s⁻¹ through a pipe of diameter 6.0 cm which narrows to 2.0 cm. Find (i) the speed in the narrow part (ii) the rate of flow. (Take π = 3.14.) (3 marks)
(Paani 6.0 cm diameter wale pipe mein 0.50 m s⁻¹ se behta hai jo tang ho kar 2.0 cm ka ho jata hai. (i) tang hisse mein speed (ii) rate of flow maloom karein. (π = 3.14.))
blocks.explanation: A ∝ d², is liye v₂ = v₁(d₁/d₂)²; rate of flow A₁v₁ hai (har jagah aik).

book_ref.quote: From equation of continuity, the mass of water discharging per second through area A is

blocks.final_answer: v₂ = 4.5 m s⁻¹; rate of flow = 1.41 × 10⁻³ m³ s⁻¹

blocks.title: Wazahat
blocks.text: Kitab ki Example 5.4 ka aakhri jawab 0.6 m chhapa hai; durust hisaab 0.5 × 10/3.14 = 1.6 m s⁻¹ hai.

blocks.prompt:
17 Using the work-energy principle, derive Bernoulli's equation for the steady flow of an ideal fluid through a pipe of varying cross-section and height. State the assumptions and write the equation in its general form. (5 marks)
(Work-energy principle se ideal fluid ke ghair-yaksaan area aur unchai wale pipe mein steady bahao ke liye Bernoulli's equation derive karein. Mafroozat likhein aur equation ki aam shakal likhein.)
blocks.explanation:
Bernoulli's equation behte fluid ke pressure ko us ki speed aur unchai se jorti hai. Mafroozat: fluid incompressible, non-viscous aur steady bahao wala hai.

Waqt t mein pipe mein fluid ka bahao lein (Fig. 5.16). Oopar ke sire par: pressure P₁, area A₁, speed v₁, unchai h₁. Neeche ke sire par: P₂, A₂, v₂, h₂.

Kaam: Oopar ke sire par force P₁A₁ hai. Peechhe ka fluid ise Δx₁ chalane mein kaam karta hai:
W₁ = F₁Δx₁ = P₁A₁Δx₁
Neeche ke sire par kaam fluid ki force ke khilaf hai, is liye manfi:
W₂ = −F₂Δx₂ = −P₂A₂Δx₂
Net kaam: W = W₁ + W₂ = P₁A₁Δx₁ − P₂A₂Δx₂ ... (5.19)
Δx₁ = v₁t, Δx₂ = v₂t: W = P₁A₁v₁t − P₂A₂v₂t
Continuity se A₁v₁ = A₂v₂, is liye A₁v₁t = A₂v₂t = V (hajm). Lehaza
W = (P₁ − P₂)V ... (5.20)
V = m/ρ se: W = (P₁ − P₂)m/ρ ... (5.21)

Energy ki tabdeeli: kaam ka aik hissa K.E. aur aik hissa gravitational P.E. badalta hai:
ΔK.E. = ½mv₂² − ½mv₁² ... (5.22)
ΔP.E. = mgh₂ − mgh₁ ... (5.23)
Energy ke conservation se:
(P₁ − P₂)m/ρ = ½mv₂² − ½mv₁² + mgh₂ − mgh₁ ... (5.24)
Tarteeb dene par (ρ/m se zarb):
P₁ + ½ρv₁² + ρgh₁ = P₂ + ½ρv₂² + ρgh₂
Yeh Bernoulli's equation hai, aksar is shakal mein:
P + ½ρv² + ρgh = mustaqil

book_ref.quote: The force on the upper end of the fluid is P₁A₁ where P₁ is the pressure

blocks.title: Wazahat
blocks.text: Har term fi unit hajm energy hai: P pressure energy, ½ρv² K.E. aur ρgh P.E. Teeno ka jama har jagah aik rehta hai, yani energy mehfooz hai.

blocks.prompt:

(Paani pipe mein neeche behta hai. Oopar ke sire (unchai 5.0 m) par pressure 2.0 × 10⁵ Pa aur speed 1.5 m s⁻¹ hai. Neeche ke sire (unchai 0) par area oopar ka aadha hai. Neeche ke sire par speed aur pressure maloom karein.)
blocks.explanation: Continuity se v₂, phir Bernoulli's equation se P₂.

book_ref.quote: where h₁ and h₂ are the heights of the upper and lower ends respectively.

steps: A₂ = A₁/2, is liye v₂ = 2v₁ = 3.0 m s⁻¹
P₂ = P₁ + ½ρ(v₁² − v₂²) + ρg(h₁ − h₂)

blocks.prompt:
19 Derive the Venturi relation P₁ − P₂ = ½ρv₂² from Bernoulli's equation, stating each approximation. What is a venturi meter used for, and what does the result tell about speed and pressure? (5 marks)
(Bernoulli's equation se Venturi relation P₁ − P₂ = ½ρv₂² derive karein aur har taqreeb (approximation) bayan karein. Venturi meter kis kaam aata hai, aur nateeja speed aur pressure ke baare mein kya batata hai?)
blocks.explanation:
Banawat (Fig. 5.22): ρ density ka fluid pipe mein behta hai. Chauray sire ka area A₁ aur tang hisse ka A₂ hai; wahan speeds v₁ aur v₂ hain. Dono hisson se jure manometer ke baazu pressures P₁ aur P₂ dikhate hain.

Qadam 1 (ufuqi pipe): Pipe ufuqi hai, is liye dono jagah average potential energy aik hai. Bernoulli's equation:
P₁ + ½ρv₁² = P₂ + ½ρv₂²
P₁ − P₂ = ½ρv₂² − ½ρv₁²
P₁ − P₂ = ½ρ(v₂² − v₁²) ... (5.25)
Is se pata chalta hai ke jahan speed zyada wahan pressure kam (P + ½ρv² = mustaqil).

Qadam 2 (continuity): A₁v₁ = A₂v₂, yani v₁ = A₂v₂/A₁. A₂ < A₁ hai, is liye v₁, v₂ ke muqable mein chhoti hai: chauray hisse mein fluid bohat aahista hai. Eq. (5.25) mein v₁ ko chhor dete hain:
P₁ − P₂ = ½ρv₂² ... (5.26)
Yeh Venturi relation hai.

Istemaal: venturi meter mein, jo liquid ke bahao ki speed naapne ka aala hai. Manometer se P₁ − P₂ naap kar v₂ = √(2(P₁ − P₂)/ρ) milti hai.

book_ref.quote: Consider a pipe within which a fluid of density ρ is flowing through different areas of cross-section

book_ref.quote: Pressure P₁ and P₂ indicate the liquid pressure at both the portions by connecting the limbs of the manometer.

blocks.prompt:
21 Derive Torricelli's theorem from Bernoulli's equation for a large tank with a small orifice, state the theorem, and explain what happens if the orifice is pointed upward. (5 marks)
(Bernoulli's equation se bare tank aur chhote suraakh ke liye Torricelli's theorem derive karein, theorem bayan karein, aur batayein ke suraakh oopar ki taraf ho to kya hota hai.)
blocks.explanation:
Banawat (Fig. 5.23): bare tank mein chhote suraakh A aur B hain. Point 1 oopar ki sateh (unchai h₁, speed v₁, pressure P₁); point 2 suraakh A (unchai h₂, efflux speed v₂, pressure P₂).

Taqreeb: suraakh itne chhote hain ke efflux speed oopar ki sateh ki speed v₁ se bohat zyada hai, is liye v₁ ≈ 0.
Bernoulli's equation:
P₁ + ρgh₁ = P₂ + ½ρv₂² + ρgh₂
Oopar ki sateh aur suraakh dono hawa ke saamne hain: P₁ = P₂ = atmospheric pressure. Kaat dene par:
ρgh₁ = ½ρv₂² + ρgh₂
½v₂² = g(h₁ − h₂)
v₂ = √(2g(h₁ − h₂)) ... (5.27)

Torricelli's theorem: Efflux ki speed us velocity ke baraabar hai jo fluid (h₁ − h₂) faasla gravity ke tehat girne par haasil karta hai.

Wazahat: efflux speed (h₁ − h₂) se girti gend ki speed jitni hai. Oopar ki sateh thori neeche aati hai aur P.E. efflux ki K.E. mein badalti hai. Agar suraakh oopar ki taraf ho (Fig. 5.23 mein B), to yeh K.E. liquid ko tank ke paani ki sateh tak utha degi. Amalan viscous nuqsaan se nateeja thora badal jata hai.

book_ref.quote: A simple application of Bernoulli's equation is shown in Fig. 5.23.

blocks.title: Wazahat
blocks.text: Kitab yahan 'Fig. 6.4' likhti hai, jo Chapter 5 mein nahi; mutalliqa shakal Fig. 5.23 hi hai.

blocks.prompt:
23 Explain, using Bernoulli's principle, the working of (i) an aeroplane wing (ii) a filter pump (iii) a carburetor (iv) a paint sprayer or perfume atomizer (v) a tall chimney. (5 marks)
(Bernoulli's principle ki madad se in ki working samjhayein: (i) hawai jahaz ka par (ii) filter pump (iii) carburetor (iv) paint sprayer ya perfume atomizer (v) lambi chimney.)
blocks.explanation:
Usool: kai aalaat fluid ki speed badalne se paida hone wale pressure ke farq se chalte hain: jahan speed zyada, wahan pressure kam.

(i) Hawai jahaz ka par: par hawa ko is tarah morta hai ke oopar streamlines neeche se zyada qareeb hon (Fig. 5.17). Qareeb streamlines par speed zyada hai, is liye oopar hawa tez aur pressure kam hai. Neeche ka zyada pressure par ko oopar dhakelta hai: yahi lift hai.

(ii) Filter pump: is ke beech mein tang hissa hai jahan nalkay ki dhaar tez ho jati hai. Wahan pressure girta hai aur side tube se hawa andar aati hai. Hawa aur paani mil kar neeche se nikalte hain (Fig. 5.19).

(iii) Carburetor: yeh Venturi duct se cylinders ko hawa aur petrol ka sahi mixture deta hai. Duct mein hawa bohat tez guzarti hai, pressure kam hota hai, aur side ke chhote inlet se petrol ke bukharat hawa mein khinch aate hain (Fig. 5.20).

(iv) Paint sprayer / perfume atomizer: rubber ki gend dabane se hawa tube se tang suraakh par tezi se nikalti hai aur liquid mein duboi tube ke oopar pressure girta hai. Atmospheric pressure liquid ko oopar hawa ki dhaar mein dhakelta hai (Fig. 5.21).

(v) Chimney: hawa ke jhonkon ke saamne lambi chimney behtar hai; chalti hawa oopar pressure kam karti hai aur dhuan oopar behta hai.

book_ref.quote: A number of devices operate by means of pressure difference that results from changes in the speed of the fluid.

blocks.title: Wazahat
blocks.text: Kitab Fig. 5.18 aur 5.19 ke neeche 'Turbulent flow' likhti hai; asal mein yeh ghoomti gend ke gird hawa aur filter pump ki shakal hain.

(Hawa (density 1.3 kg m⁻³) hawai jahaz ke par ke oopar 70 m s⁻¹ aur neeche 60 m s⁻¹ se chalti hai. Par ka area 20 m² hai. Par ko patla aur ufuqi maan kar (i) pressure ka farq (ii) lift force maloom karein.)

book_ref.quote: the wing will be forced upward and the lift of an aeroplane is due to this effect

blocks.prompt:
25 Explain viscous drag and state Stokes' law. Describe how a droplet falling through air reaches terminal velocity, and derive the expression vₜ = 2gr²ρ/9η. (5 marks)
(Viscous drag samjhayein aur Stokes' law bayan karein. Batayein ke hawa mein girta qatra terminal velocity tak kaise pohanchta hai, aur vₜ = 2gr²ρ/9η derive karein.)
blocks.explanation:
Viscosity aur drag: behte fluid ki tehon ke darmiyan ragar ka asar viscosity hai; yeh batati hai ke liquid ki aik teh ko doosri par khiskane ke liye kitni force chahiye (coefficient η). Liquids aur gases ki viscosity zero nahi, is liye un mein chalti cheez par rokne wali force lagti hai jise drag force kehte hain; yeh speed barhne se barhti hai.

Stokes' law: η viscosity wale fluid mein v speed se aahista chalte r radius ke kurre par drag force
F = 6πηrv ... (5.28)
Tez speed par force speed ke seedha mutanasib nahi rehti.

Terminal velocity: amoodi girta paani ka qatra (maslan kohre ka) pehle gravity se tezi se accelerate karta hai. Speed barhne se oopar ki drag barhti hai. Net force
Net force = Wazan − Drag force ... (5.29)
Aakhir drag wazan ke baraabar ho jati hai; net force zero aur qatra mustaqil speed se girta hai jise terminal velocity vₜ kehte hain.

Derivation: Stokes' law ki drag ko wazan ke baraabar rakhne par:
0 = mg − 6πηrvₜ
vₜ = mg/6πηr ... (5.30)
Qatre ka mass m = ρV, jahan V = (4/3)πr³. Is liye
vₜ = (4/3)πr³ρg/6πηr
vₜ = 2gr²ρ/9η ... (5.31)
Yani terminal velocity radius ke murabba ke seedha mutanasib hai.
